
\subsection{The D9 terminal carrier and endpoint reserve frame}
\label{app:D9-terminal-reserve-frame}

This subsection records the symbolic high-even terminal/reserve frame for the
new $D=9$ active anchor.  It is valid for every even $m>9$; the low moduli
$m=4,6,8$ are left to the finite pointwise certificates.

Use the root-flat chart
\[
K_{9,m}=\{x\in(\mathbb Z/m\mathbb Z)^9:\sum_i x_i=0\},\qquad ij=u_j-u_i.
\]
The last stage has height $s_7=7$.  The chronological terminal triple is
$(8,2,3)$, hence the shifted root vertices are
\[
(8,2,3)+7=(6,0,1).
\]
Thus the terminal carrier is the affine $A_2$-plane
\[
Q_T=q_T+\langle 06,01\rangle,
\qquad q_T=(0,0,2,2,-4,0,0,0,0).
\]
The terminal alignment table is
\[
\begin{array}{c|c}
\text{item}&\text{value}\\\hline
\text{terminal triple}&(8,2,3)\\
\text{root vertices}&(6,0,1)\\
\text{basis edges}&(0,6),(0,1)\\
\text{rows}&(-1,0),(1,1),(0,-1)\\
\text{permutation}&(0,1,2)\\
\text{signs}&(1,1,-1).
\end{array}
\]
This is the same terminal $A_2$ alignment used for the $D=5$ and $D=7$ anchors,
with $t=6$.

The endpoint reserve is placed on the affine rank-two plane
\[
Q_R=q_R+\langle 24,35\rangle,
\qquad q_R=(3,4,3,5,-15,0,0,0,0).
\]
The $D+3=12$ reserve singletons are obtained from the coefficient grid
$(a,b)\in\{0,1,2,3\}\times\{0,1,2\}$:
\[
U_{a,b}=q_R+a(24)+b(35).
\]
The coefficient differences have entries of absolute value $<10$, so the twelve
sites are pairwise distinct for every even $m>9$.

The disjointness checks use the following elementary separation criterion.  If
$A=a+\langle V\rangle$ and $B=b+\langle W\rangle$ are two affine subspaces of
$K_{9,m}$, and if an integer functional $\ell$ satisfies
\[
\ell(V)=\ell(W)=0,\qquad 0<|\ell(a-b)|<m,
\]
then $A\cap B=\varnothing$ modulo $m$.  The machine ledger supplies such a
functional for each pair consisting of $Q_T$ and a splice support, and for each
pair consisting of $Q_R$ and either a splice support or $Q_T$.  The largest
absolute difference is $4$ for terminal-vs-splice checks and $9$ for
reserve-vs-forbidden checks.  Hence all these spaces are disjoint for every
$m>9$.

The JSON ledger \texttt{d9\_terminal\_reserve\_frame\_candidate.json} and the
script \texttt{verify\_d9\_terminal\_reserve\_frame.py} recompute all separating
functionals and the twelve reserve sites.
